summary: The compliance review of the product 'FaceFin: One-Look Personal Loans' identified several findings against the reviewed RBI rules. While some low-severity findings were noted, no compliance gaps were identified for those items. However, three high-severity issues were found: (1) the product stores biometric data on its servers, which is prohibited under RBI guidelines; (2) the product stores data in servers located outside India, violating the requirement for data to be stored only in India; and (3) the product collects personal data without providing the borrower with the necessary consent options and data management rights as required by the guidelines.
